title: The Little Chaplet of Saint Anne
description: Chaplet of St. Anne for family and perseverance · ~10 min

steps.versicle: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.
steps.title: Sign of the Cross
On the medal of Saint Anne
Five Hail Marys — after each: "Jesus, Mary, and Saint Anne, grant the favor I ask."

steps.mysteryTitle: In honor of Mary, the channel of all grace

steps.versicle: Good Saint Anne, mother of her who is our life, our sweetness, and our hope:
steps.response: Pray to her for us, and obtain our request.

st_anne_collect.text: O God, Who didst vouchsafe to blessed Anne the grace to be the mother of her who was to bring forth Thine only-begotten Son: grant, in Thy mercy, that we who devoutly venerate her memory may be aided by her intercession. Through the same Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, world without end. Amen.
st_anne_collect.source: The traditional Roman collect of Saint Anne

hail_mary.text:
Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women,
and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God,
pray for us sinners,
now and at the hour of our death.
Amen.
hail_mary.latin:
Ave Maria, gratia plena, Dominus tecum.
Benedicta tu in mulieribus,
et benedictus fructus ventris tui, Iesus.
Sancta Maria, Mater Dei,
ora pro nobis peccatoribus,
nunc et in hora mortis nostrae.
Amen.

glory_be.text:
Glory be to the Father,
and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit,
as it was in the beginning,
is now, and ever shall be,
world without end.
Amen.
glory_be.latin:
Gloria Patri, et Filio,
et Spiritui Sancto,
sicut erat in principio,
et nunc, et semper,
et in saecula saeculorum.
Amen.

schedule_note.note: The Little Chaplet of Saint Anne (from 1875): three parts — in honor of Jesus, Mary, and Saint Anne — each praying one Our Father, five Hail Marys with the after-each-Hail-Mary invocation "Jesus, Mary, and Saint Anne: grant the favor I ask." (carried in each group’s title, as the counted BeadGroup step has no per-bead suffix), and one Glory Be; the received "Good Saint Anne, mother of her who is our life…" versicle and the traditional collect close it. The after-each invocation is the received formula of the chaplet; its per-bead rhythm is the user’s to keep while counting. Daily anchor 09:00.
schedule_note.structure: sign of the cross; medal invocation; 3 parts of (1 Our Father + 5 Hail Marys with the invocation + 1 Glory Be); closing versicle and collect
schedule_note.invocation_source: The Little Chaplet of Saint Anne (received form from 1875; recitations of the Sainte-Anne-de-Beaupré tradition)
